home.title: Turn your residues into energy
home.subtitle: The marketplace where livestock farms, dairies, olive mills and food producers find biogas plants for their manure, whey, olive mill wastewater and residues. With supply agreements and secure payments.
home.sellersBody: List what you have, how much and when, for free. Get offers from plants in your area and get paid after every delivery.
home.buyersBody: Find reliable feedstock nearby, compare distance and biogas potential, and manage supply agreements, deliveries and payments in one place.
home.how1Body: The producer states the type, quantity, availability and price per tonne (or whether they pay to have it collected).
home.how2Body: The plant makes an offer, both sides agree on terms and transport, and sign a supply agreement.
home.how3Body: Every delivery is recorded with its weighed quantity and paid through the platform.
home.catalogLink: See the feedstocks biogas plants accept
